sloka: कैलासं लङ्घयित्वाथ दशग्रीवः स रावणः ।आससाद महातेजा इन्द्रलोकं निशाचरः ।। ७.२७.१ ॥
transliteration: kailāsaṁ laṅghayitvātha daśagrīvaḥ sa rāvaṇaḥ ।āsasāda mahātejā indralokaṁ niśācaraḥ ।। 7.27.1 ॥

translations.english: After crossing the Kailasa mountain, that greatly powerful ten-necked demon Ravana reached the world of Indra.
